description: Rez (United Game Artists, 2001), recompiled for the TrimUI Brick.
features: 60 fps: the stages are drawn at 60 frames a second, where the original draws them at 30.
Resolution: 1024x768 (the Brick's screen) or 640x480, set in Recomp Options.
Vibration: Off, Low, Medium or High, set in Recomp Options.
changelog: Licence notices brought up to date.
